Aurora Lake lodges, igloos and rooms in Ranua Lapland
We offer a suitable accommodation option for every need. Stay comfortably in our affordable and cozy guesthouse rooms, our unique and immersive igloos, or our high-end Aurora Lake Lodges – premium Northern Lights cabins completed in autumn 2025.
In addition to our accommodation options, our premises include a restaurant that is open every day of the year. We also offer a wide range of year-round activities in cooperation with Lupland Adventures .
new aurora lake lodges available for bookings!
New high-quality lodges for 2–6 people, equipped with all modern comforts and located by a beautiful lakeside view.
Book Your stay here!
immersive Glass Igloos in Finnish Lapland
Enjoy adventurous glass igloo accommodation with us in a totally new way. While staying in our compact glass igloo, you can experience Lapland’s natural phenomena at their best.
book your igloo experience now
Stay in our main building, built in the 1940s
Our B&B Guesthouse has been serving its customers ever since the 1940s, and plenty of details referring to past decades can be seen both in the guesthouse s courtyard and inside the buildings themselves. Our triple and quadruble rooms are located in mainbuilding.
Our single and double rooms are located in separate building.  Book your comfortable and economy stay in a historic setting and far away from the hustle and bustle of the city.
Book your room now
Authentic Lapland Activities Without Crowds
We offer wide range of top level activities together with Lupland Adventures. Year-round nature activities make your holiday unforgettable.
Lupland Adventures also offer taxi service and rental clothes.
Check our activities
Restaurant in Ranua - at your service every day
Arctic Guesthouse & Igloos Restaurant is located inside the main building of the inn. Our restaurant serves its customers all year round and is open from 12 pm to 9pm in winter season (1.12-31.3) and 12pm to 7pm in the summer season.
In our cozy restaurant, you can enjoy cold and warm drinks, savory and sweet snacks, lunch and dinner. All our room rates also include a breakfast that is served from 8am to 10am in winter season (1.12-31.3). From the menu, you will find dishes prepared with high quality, domestic ingredients for every taste.
Learn more about our restaurant
Stories from Ranua travel blog
In our travel blog you will find a lot of useful information, as well as interesting stories about our own and business, as well as information about traveling in Finnish Lapland. In our latest blog post, we will tell you about the things that you can do in Ranua during summer .

high level new aurora lake lodges waiting for you
Aurora Lake Lodges offer top level comfort  for 2-6 people. Lodges are located on the shores of lake Ranua, ideal for experiencing stunning nature phenomenon such as the Northern lights and mid-summer nightless night in Finnish Lapland
Book now
Enjoy your holiday in the most comfortable lodges
High level accommodation near the activities
Our brand-new Aurora Lake Lodges offer high-quality accommodation right by the lake with a beautiful north-facing view. From these lodges, you can admire ever-changing seasonal landscapes and have excellent chances to witness the Northern Lights dancing above the sky.
The total area of each cabin is 40 square meters, featuring 30
m² downstairs and a 10 m² loft providing extra sleeping space.
all you need for comfort stay
Inside, you’ll find all the comforts you need:
A mini kitchen equipped with a refrigerator, microwave and electric kettle.
Private shower and toilet
Beds and a cozy living area with scenic lake views
The loft offers additional sleeping space, and the cabins can accommodate 4+2 guests. The beds are twin beds that can be combined into a double bed if desired.
calm option near the nature
Aurora Lake Lodges, modern comfort meets elegant design and the authentic tranquility of Lapland – the perfect place to relax, watch the Northern Lights, and enjoy breathtaking lake views all year round.
The first 5 cabins are available on 20 th of December and next 5 will be
available on beginning of October 2026.
Our project includes the construction of a total of 10 new Aurora Lake Lodges designed for Northern Lights viewing. The first five lodges were completed on December 20, 2025, and the remaining five will be completed in October 2026.
The goal of the project is to expand our accommodation capacity with high-end aurora lodges that meet the high expectations of international travelers.
Our project has received funding from the European Union’s Rural Development Fund through the Lapland Centre for Economic Development, Transport and the Environment (ELY Centre), now known as the Lapland Vitality Centre.

Frequently Asked Questions - Arctic Guesthouse & Igloos
Skip to content
+358 50 378 7989
Contact us
Store
Menu
Frequently asked questions
Where is Ranua located?
Ranua is located in southern Lapland between the cities of Rovaniemi and Oulu. We are located about one hour away from Rovaniemi and a bit more than two hours away from Oulu.
What is the easiest way to arrive to Ranua?
The easiest way is to take a taxi. Our partner Lupland Adventures offers taxi tranfers between Ranua and Rovaniemi. You can book the transfer HERE .
We would recommend either renting a car or taking a bus.
Our partner have a bus transpoint from Rovaniemi Airport to Ranua from monday to friday at 9:50 am and 4:10 pm.
They also go back to Rovaniemi Airport from Ranua at 6:50 am and 2:20 pm.
There are daily buses from Rovaniemi and Oulu to Ranua. You can check the bus schedules on  Matkahuolto  website. The buses depart from Rovaniemi and Oulu center and arrive to the center of Ranua which is only about half a kilometer away from our guesthouse.
Along with these options, we can also offer our customers an airport transfer service through private service. This service can be booked through email.
It s also possible to take a local taxi. If you need help to get a taxi, please contact us.
What is the easiest way to arrive to Ranua?
The easiest way is to take a taxi. Our partner Lupland Adventures offers taxi tranfers between Ranua and Rovaniemi. You can book the transfer HERE .
We would recommend either renting a car or taking a bus.
There are daily buses from Rovaniemi and Oulu to Ranua. You can check the bus schedules on  Matkahuolto  website. The buses depart from Rovaniemi and Oulu center and arrive to the center of Ranua which is only about half a kilometer away from our guesthouse.
Shuttle bus take you from Rovaniemi Airport to Rovaniemi main bus station.
Along with these options, we can also offer our customers an airport transfer service through private service. This service can be booked through our webstore.
It s also possible to take a local taxi. If you need help to get a taxi, please contact us.
What activities do you offer? What can I do in Ranua?
We offer our customers a  wide selection of activities  throughout the year. Our most popular activities in winter are husky ride, Lupland Activity Park Ranua Zoo visit, ice fishing, gym and guided northern lights hunting. Our partner Lupland Adventures also offers guided tours to most beautiful places in daytime. They also have e-fatbike and snowshoe rental and possibility to make guided tours using them.
Along with our own selection, there are also lots of nature entertainment options available at Ranua Resort. You can also find a comprehensive blog post about winter activities in Ranua on our blog.
Ranua in general is a great place for experiencing the nature of Lapland and our own location is also ideal for nature activities.
Do you provide extra beds?
We can provide extra mattresses both for the igloos and the guesthouse with the charge of extra sheets which is 40€ /person /day.
Can we see the Northern lights while staying with you?
Ranua is located close to the Arctic Circle, which means that our town is a really good option when one is looking for northern lights. Compared to cities such as Rovaniemi, we don’t have light pollution even in the center of the village, which means that with good luck you will be able to see the northern lights directly from our accommodation.
The thing to note about in terms of Northern lights is that we can never guarantee that you can see them while staying with us as it is always down to both the space weather and the weather conditions itself. There are plenty of services to check the aurora activity in Lapland. In our opinion, one of the best ones is  Foreca’s Auroras and space weather service . Seeing the northern lights strongly depends on the space weather and of course whether the sky is clear or not.
Can we have dinner or lunch while staying with you?
Yes, we have a restaurant and cafeteria that is open daily in the summer from 12 am to 7pm and in the winter from 12 am to 21 . You can check our menu on our restaurant page .
We also have dining service available for larger groups. This service can be pre-booked through email for example.
We booked a room in the guesthouse / glass igloo. What does the price include?
All our guesthouse and igloo bookings include a free parking, WiFi connection in the public areas of the guesthouse, buffet breakfast, access to the electric sauna in our guesthouse’s main building.
Our guests can also use electric sauna free of charge and all the igloos also have their own WiFi connection. You can find more information about our igloos amenities on the igloos own page .
We booked an igloo. Does it have its own toilet and bathroom?
There is a composting eco toilet inside the igloo. The brand new bathroom and toilet is located inside our main building and you can use it free of charge.
Can I change my booking?
We always try to provide you this option. The best way to do it is by contacting us through email . Remember to include your current booking details and the changes that you would like to make.
Is the cancellation free of charge?
Please read the booking and cancellation conditions in more detail.
Are pets welcome to your accommodation?
Arctic Guesthouse & Igloos is a pet-friendly property. This means that pets are welcome in all our accommodation options. For cats and dogs we charge a one-time fee of € 20, regardless of the length of the accommodation.
Do we need to bring our own sheets and towels?
No. Sheets and towels are always provided by us and included in the booking rates.
